shard.name: Terraria (TShock)
shard.description: Terraria multiplayer server running TShock for permissions, anti-griefing protection, and plugins.
shard.author: Pryaxis & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# TShock for Terraria Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq unzip

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p Worlds

if [ -z "${TSHOCK_VERSION}" ] || [ "${TSHOCK_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest TShock release from GitHub..."
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Pryaxis/TShock/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | contains("linux-x64")) | .browser_download_url')
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Pryaxis/TShock/releases/download/${TSHOCK_VERSION}/TShock-${TSHOCK_VERSION}-linux-x64.zip"
fi

echo "Downloading TShock from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o tshock.zip -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Extracting TShock..."
unzip -q -o tshock.zip
rm -f tshock.zip

chmod +x TShock.Server
echo "TShock installation completed!"
